skills.name: Towns in Africa: urban landscapes and informal activities

worked_example.problem: Give two examples of informal activities seen in a Cameroonian town and say why they are called informal.
steps: Examples: motorbike taxis (benskin) and street hawking.
They are informal because they are not registered with the State and pay little or no tax.
worked_example.answer: Motorbike taxis and street hawking; they are not registered and pay little tax.

cards.idea: A town is a large settlement where most people work in industry, trade and services.
The CBD has offices, banks and big shops; residential quarters may be planned or unplanned.
Informal activities are small unregistered jobs: hawking, benskin, bayam-sellam.

pick.s: A woman sells roasted plantain by the roadside.
A teacher works in a government school.
A young man repairs phones in a call-box.
A clerk works in a bank.

check.prompt: Is this a formal or an informal activity? {X.s}

misconceptions.explain: Ask: is the job registered with the State and does it pay taxes?

solution: Formal jobs are registered and pay taxes and social security; informal ones are not.
